heading_en: Calculation of Expected Shortfall Assuming Market Stress
summary_ja: 市場混乱時を想定した期待ショート・フォールの算式（ES_{R,S}、ES_{F,C}、ES_{R,C}）と、低減したリスク・ファクター・ストレス期間等に関する要件、相関の反映、監督当局による観測期間の指示を定める。
summary_en: Sets the formula for expected shortfall under market stress (using ES_{R,S}, ES_{F,C} and ES_{R,C}), the requirements for the reduced set of risk factors, the stress period, etc., the reflection of correlations, and the supervisor's power to require a shorter observation period.
paragraphs: An Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal model approach shall calculate, for all trading desks using the internal model approach, the market risk equivalent amount calculated by expected shortfall assuming market stress by the following formula. {{F:p341i0}} ES is the market risk equivalent amount calculated by expected shortfall assuming market stress; ES_{R,S} is the market risk equivalent amount calculated by expected shortfall assuming market stress for the reduced set of risk factors; ES_{R,C} is the market risk equivalent amount calculated by expected shortfall based on the most recent 12 months for the reduced set of risk factors; ES_{F,C} is the market risk equivalent amount calculated by expected shortfall based on the most recent 12 months for all risk factors.

In making the calculation under the preceding paragraph, all of the following requirements shall be satisfied. (i) The reduced set of risk factors satisfies all of the following requirements and has been approved by the Commissioner of the Financial Services Agency: (a) They are modellable risk factors with a sufficient observation period; (b) The average over the most recent 12 weeks of the ratio obtained by dividing the expected shortfall of the reduced set of risk factors by the expected shortfall based on all risk factors is 75 percent or more; (ii) The data relating to expected shortfall calculated in the stress period shall be equally weighted; (iii) The stress period relating to ES_{R,S} in the formula of the preceding paragraph shall be reviewed at least once per quarter and when a material change occurs in the risk factors; (iv) Where the stress period relating to ES_{R,S} in the formula of the preceding paragraph is changed, the reduced set of risk factors shall be reviewed; (v) The reference date of the reviews under the preceding two items shall coincide with the reference date of the modellability test of risk factors; (vi) The data used in calculating ES_{F,C} in the formula of the preceding paragraph shall be updated at least once per quarter and when a significant movement in market prices occurs.

Where the expected shortfall in paragraph (1) is for the same risk class, correlations observed from historical data may be reflected. In this case, the correlations shall be consistent with the liquidity horizon n provided for in paragraph (3) of the preceding Article for each risk factor, and documentation concerning the calculation and use of the correlations shall be prepared.

The expected shortfall in paragraph (1) shall appropriately take into account the non-linear risk of options and volatility surfaces in the risk factor categories provided for in paragraph (3) of the preceding Article.
In making the calculation under paragraph (1), the internal model approach shall include all material risk factors relating to the risk tolerance set by the trading desk.
In making the calculation under paragraph (1), the historical simulation method, the Monte Carlo simulation method or other appropriate measurement methods may be used.

Where the Commissioner of the Financial Services Agency judges that price volatility has risen significantly in a short period and that it is appropriate to reflect price movements more appropriately, the Commissioner may require the calculation of expected shortfall assuming market stress using a shorter observation period. In this case, the observation period shall be six months or more.
